terminology.diagnosisBeforeStage: IRIS stage применяется только после диагностики хронической почечной патологии
terminology.stabilityRule: стадируется стабильный адекватно гидратированный пациент; acute, pre-renal и post-renal компоненты отделяются
terminology.substageRule: stage, persistent renal proteinuria substage и blood-pressure/target-organ substage хранятся отдельно с treatment-state
terminology.markerRule: creatinine интерпретируется с muscle mass, fasted state и методом; discordant SDMA не усредняется
terminology.snapshotRule: новая стадия не переписывает старые лабораторные и treatment snapshots
terminology.protocolRule: числовые границы, препараты, дозы, диетический состав, infusion и biopsy technique подключаются только версионированным reviewed protocol

commonHistoryQuestions.text: Когда изменились жажда и мочеиспускание: недели/месяцы или внезапно?
Как менялись масса и мышечная кондиция?
Какой аппетит, есть ли тошнота или рвота?
Были ли обезвоживание, жара, диарея, анестезия или плохое питьё?
Есть ли датированные creatinine, SDMA, моча, давление или imaging?
Как собрали мочу и был ли активный осадок, кровь или инфекция?
Как, сколько раз и в какой обстановке измеряли давление?
Есть ли внезапное изменение зрения, дезориентация, судороги или слабость?
Какие лекарства и добавки получает пациент и когда?
Есть ли диабет, гипертиреоз, инфекция, камни, воспаление или опухоль?
Что и сколько пациент фактически ест?
Что владелец реально может отслеживать дома: воду, еду, массу, мочу, хорошие и плохие дни?
Какой текущий объём мочи, нет ли олигурии, анурии или затруднения?

variants.title: Ранняя неазотемическая хроническая болезнь почек
variants.diagnosticTruth: Хроническая почечная аномалия может быть подтверждена стойким renal concentrating defect, renal proteinuria, persistent functional marker or structural disease даже при reference creatinine.

presentations.complaint: Несколько анализов показывают несоответствующе разбавленную мочу, хотя креатинин ещё в референсе.

historyAnswers.renal_comorbidity: Endocrine, diet, water and medication causes assessed.

examFindings.finding: Repeated appropriate samples show persistent renal-compatible concentrating defect.
Water, drugs, endocrine and pre/postrenal causes are assessed before CKD label.

investigations.result: Authored persistent concentration and sediment context.

followUp.timing: authored stable repeat and early CKD trend

outcomes.safe: Early CKD remains possible without azotemia but requires persistence.
outcomes.unsafe: One dilute sample or normal creatinine decides the case.

ownerCommunication: Explain why repeat and exclusion are needed before staging.

presentations.complaint: Креатинин нормален, но SDMA или UPC остаются повышенными в повторных подходящих образцах.

historyAnswers.urine_sample_sediment: Inactive sediment and collection method documented.
historyAnswers.renal_comorbidity: Prerenal protein and systemic causes assessed.

examFindings.finding: Persistent SDMA and/or renal-origin UPC supports early kidney disease.
Active sediment, infection, blood, systemic protein and marker limitations are excluded/flagged.

investigations.result: Authored serial UPC with inactive sediment.
Authored stable discordant or concordant marker trend.

outcomes.safe: Marker signal is corroborated and localized.
outcomes.unsafe: One SDMA or dipstick becomes a complete CKD/glomerular diagnosis.

ownerCommunication: Explain why protein source matters before kidney labeling.

presentations.complaint: Визуализация показывает хронически совместимое изменение почек, хотя функция ещё сохранена.

historyAnswers.renal_comorbidity: Congenital, inflammatory, obstructive and incidental possibilities assessed.
historyAnswers.urine_output_current: Output and obstruction red flags checked.

examFindings.finding: Authored bilateral/renal structural pattern supports chronic disease.
A solitary cyst or anatomic variant does not automatically create CKD.

outcomes.safe: Imaging is interpreted as evidence, not rendered diagnosis.
outcomes.unsafe: Renderer converts any cyst into CKD.

ownerCommunication: Explain what is structural evidence versus incidental finding.

variants.title: Стабильная хроническая болезнь почек с лёгкой азотемией
variants.diagnosticTruth: Повторяемая renal azotemia or SDMA in an adequately hydrated stable patient with chronic kidney evidence supports staging; apparent wellness does not negate CKD.

presentations.complaint: Пожилой пациент чувствует себя обычно, но скрининг и повтор показывают стабильную renal dysfunction.

historyAnswers.volume_loss_event: Adequately hydrated and no acute volume loss.

examFindings.finding: Repeated stable renal markers plus urine/chronic evidence.
UPC and BP/target-organ fields are separately completed or explicitly pending.

investigations.result: Authored UPC substage or pending flag.

followUp.timing: stage-specific reviewed interval with clinical baseline

outcomes.safe: Asymptomatic CKD receives complete baseline and proportionate follow-up.
outcomes.unsafe: Eating well is used to declare normal kidneys.

ownerCommunication: Explain stage versus current quality of life.

presentations.complaint: Жажда и мочеиспускание изменены месяцами, но масса и renal markers относительно стабильны.

historyAnswers.renal_comorbidity: Diabetes, hyperthyroidism and other PU/PD causes assessed.

examFindings.finding: PU/PD is compatible with stable CKD but not specific.
Diabetes, hyperthyroidism and other conditions may coexist and remain authored differentials.

outcomes.safe: CKD and coexisting PU/PD causes are evaluated together.

ownerCommunication: Explain why nutrition/home monitoring do not replace lab substaging.

presentations.complaint: Creatinine и SDMA у стабильного CKD-пациента указывают на разные стадии.

historyAnswers.renal_comorbidity: Breed, thyroid/adrenal and lab confounders assessed.

examFindings.finding: Muscle, fasting, breed, hemolysis, assay and biologic variation are reviewed.
No mathematical mean; uncertainty persists and reviewed precaution considers the higher stage.

investigations.result: Higher-stage precaution or specialist review recorded.

followUp.timing: stable same-method repeat and specialist review if persistent

outcomes.safe: Discordance is explicit and conservatively interpreted.
outcomes.unsafe: Values are averaged or the lower stage chosen for convenience.

ownerCommunication: Explain why two imperfect markers can disagree.

variants.title: Умеренно выраженная симптомная хроническая болезнь почек
variants.diagnosticTruth: Симптомная стабильная CKD имеет осложнения и клиническую нагрузку, но любое ухудшение сначала проверяется на acute, volume-responsive и иные обратимые компоненты.

presentations.complaint: У CKD-пациента постепенно снижаются аппетит, масса и мышцы, но нет шока или непрекращающейся рвоты.

historyAnswers.actual_diet_intake: Actual intake, not prescribed diet only.
historyAnswers.renal_comorbidity: Oral, GI and systemic alternatives assessed.

examFindings.finding: Documented weight/MCS/appetite decline in stable CKD.
Oral, GI, endocrine, neoplastic and other causes remain evaluated.

outcomes.safe: Clinical burden and alternatives guide reviewed support.
outcomes.unsafe: All appetite loss is called uremia and handled by diet only.

ownerCommunication: Track what is actually eaten and good/bad days without moralizing.

presentations.complaint: Creatinine выше прежнего на фоне рвоты, плохого питья или обезвоживания.

examFindings.finding: Volume depletion can raise renal markers and must be stabilized before restaging.
GI loss, infection, obstruction, toxin and drug exposure are assessed.

investigations.result: Peak and new stable value stored separately.

followUp.timing: during stabilization and after hydration for new baseline

outcomes.safe: Peak and stable baseline remain separate snapshots.

ownerCommunication: Explain why the stage cannot be decided from the sick-day value.

presentations.complaint: У стабильного CKD-пациента выявлены анемия, фосфорный, калиевый или кислотно-основный сдвиг.

historyAnswers.renal_comorbidity: Blood loss, inflammation, nutrition and other causes assessed.

examFindings.finding: Authored anemia/mineral/electrolyte/acid-base pattern linked to stable CKD.
Blood loss, inflammation, hemolysis, diet and medication effects remain assessed.

outcomes.safe: Complication is treated as specific longitudinal problem.
outcomes.unsafe: One abnormality generates a drug/diet protocol or is assumed renal.

ownerCommunication: Explain why the same laboratory abnormality can have more than one cause.

variants.title: Продвинутая CKD или острое ухудшение на её фоне
variants.diagnosticTruth: Uremic/advanced CKD and abrupt decline from documented baseline require immediate perfusion, urine-output, electrolyte, acid-base and obstruction assessment before stage decisions.

presentations.complaint: CKD-пациент не ест, повторно рвёт, обезвожен, имеет язвы или изменённое сознание.

historyAnswers.urine_output_current: Output quantified; oliguria/anuria and obstruction checked.
historyAnswers.prior_renal_snapshots: Chronic baseline documented or absent flag.

examFindings.finding: Perfusion, hydration, mentation and urine output require emergency route.
Electrolytes, acid-base and obstruction are assessed before planned staging.

investigations.result: Authored external result or immediate referral.
Current QoL and later stage snapshot.

followUp.timing: continuous hospital trend then new stable baseline

outcomes.safe: Emergency support and reversible-cause search precede restaging.
outcomes.unsafe: Patient waits for routine SDMA/UPC while unstable.

ownerCommunication: Separate immediate stabilization, prognosis and later stage discussion.

presentations.complaint: Renal values резко выросли относительно сохранённого стабильного CKD baseline.

historyAnswers.prior_renal_snapshots: Old stable snapshot and current values linked.

examFindings.finding: Current rapid deviation is preserved beside old stable snapshot.
Volume, infection, obstruction, toxin/drug and other acute causes are evaluated.

followUp.timing: acute trend and post-stabilization new baseline

outcomes.safe: Old record remains immutable and new baseline is created later.
outcomes.unsafe: Current stage retroactively overwrites prior visits.

ownerCommunication: Explain which part may be reversible versus chronic.

presentations.complaint: Тяжёлая хроническая болезнь требует честного разговора о симптомах, прогнозе, referral и качестве жизни.

historyAnswers.home_monitoring_capacity: Good/bad days, interaction, mobility, food/water tracked.

examFindings.finding: Pain, nausea, food, hydration, mobility, interaction and good/bad days are serially assessed.
Costly referral is not the only moral choice; safe supportive/palliative route has no hidden punishment.

investigations.result: Authored QoL trend and owner goals.

followUp.timing: short symptom/QoL review agreed with owner

outcomes.safe: Plan matches patient comfort and informed owner goals.
outcomes.unsafe: Laboratory improvement or expensive referral is the sole victory condition.

ownerCommunication: Offer honest options, costs and burdens without coercion.

variants.title: Протеинурический или гломерулярный почечный паттерн
variants.diagnosticTruth: Renal proteinuria is persistent protein loss after pre-renal and post-renal sources are excluded; magnitude may suggest glomerular involvement but does not define etiology without further workup.

presentations.complaint: Несколько UPC в подходящих образцах остаются повышенными при неактивном осадке.

historyAnswers.urine_sample_sediment: Method, inactive sediment and culture context documented.

examFindings.finding: Serial UPC in inactive samples supports renal proteinuria.
Substage and cause are kept separate.

followUp.timing: same-method UPC, albumin, BP and stage trend

outcomes.safe: Renal proteinuria is substaged without inventing etiology.
outcomes.unsafe: Dipstick or one UPC creates glomerulonephritis.

presentations.complaint: Протеинурия сопровождается низким альбумином, отёком/выпотом или признаками возможного тромботического риска.

historyAnswers.renal_comorbidity: Liver, GI, inflammation and neoplasia alternatives assessed.

examFindings.finding: Hypoalbuminemia with edema/effusion or thrombotic concern requires specialist risk route.
Hepatic synthesis, GI loss and inflammation are considered.

followUp.timing: urgent risk result then serial protein/clinical review

outcomes.safe: Systemic risk and alternative causes are addressed.
outcomes.unsafe: Generator invents antithrombotic treatment or assumes every low albumin is renal.

ownerCommunication: Explain urgent signs without promising a specific prophylactic protocol.

presentations.complaint: Стойкая renal proteinuria требует поиска инфекционного, воспалительного или неопластического триггера и обсуждения specialist route.

historyAnswers.renal_comorbidity: Regional exposure, inflammation, neoplasia and infection clues authored.
historyAnswers.home_monitoring_capacity: Biopsy/referral preferences and feasible monitoring documented.

examFindings.finding: No universal panel; tests follow authored exposure/systemic clues.
Biopsy is discussed only if result changes care and risk is acceptable; refusal preserves monitoring.

followUp.timing: targeted result or serial UPC/stage plan if biopsy declined

outcomes.safe: Declining biopsy does not erase safe monitoring.
outcomes.unsafe: Universal panel or biopsy is the only accepted answer.

ownerCommunication: Discuss what each test could change and its burden.

variants.title: Гипертензивный паттерн при хронической болезни почек
variants.diagnosticTruth: Systemic blood-pressure substage is based on standardized serial measurements and target-organ risk, independent of CKD stage; established target-organ damage permits urgent action without prolonged confirmation.

presentations.complaint: Стандартизованные серии давления остаются высокими, но поражения органов-мишеней не найдено.

historyAnswers.prior_renal_snapshots: CKD stage and previous BP preserved.

examFindings.finding: Repeated standardized series supports hypertensive risk substage.
No current damage still requires reviewed plan and same-method recheck.

investigations.result: Authored persistent BP and absent damage.

followUp.timing: reviewed same-method BP and renal function checkpoint

outcomes.safe: BP substage is independent and reproducible.
outcomes.unsafe: One stressed value becomes chronic hypertension.

ownerCommunication: Explain acclimatization, series and target-organ risk.

presentations.complaint: У CKD-пациента внезапно ухудшилось зрение, найдена retinal lesion или появились неврологические признаки.

historyAnswers.target_organ_signs: Acute blindness, disorientation or seizure authored.
historyAnswers.blood_pressure_context: Immediate series with context; long confirmation not required if damage present.

examFindings.finding: Authored retinal/neurologic damage plus high BP triggers urgent route.
Ophthalmic finding is a fixed exam result, not derived from BP number by UI.

outcomes.safe: Urgent plan starts without weeks of confirmation.
outcomes.unsafe: Blindness waits because only one visit series exists.

ownerCommunication: Explain target-organ emergency and uncertain visual recovery without promise.

presentations.complaint: Давление изменилось после утверждённого плана; нужно обновить текущую подстадию, не потеряв исходную серию.

historyAnswers.blood_pressure_context: Same-method current series and old untreated series.
historyAnswers.prior_renal_snapshots: Renal function before and after preserved.

examFindings.finding: Current designation includes treatment-state and old series remains immutable.
Weakness, hypotensive pattern or marked renal change is not automatic victory.

followUp.timing: same-method serial BP and renal function

outcomes.safe: Response is tracked without losing baseline or ignoring harm.
outcomes.unsafe: Fast drop is marked win and old substage overwritten.

ownerCommunication: Explain why current substage includes treatment-state.
